name: @emsenn/language-codecs
description: The codec layer of language: reversible bridge morphisms between representations — fiber compile (load), surface→structure (parse/articulate), structure→surface (render) — bound as one round-trip surface.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-boundary/copy-dmts-to-dts.mjs dist
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".tmp/test-dist/**/*.test.mjs"
